messages:
joanne: Quick update 9: were opening a limited preview for Dedicated mi500 pools in APAC (ap-sin) and EU (eu-amsterdam). This wave is opt-in for customers who want a cost-efficient, mid-tier GPU between a100x and mi300. Preview docs + sign-up: https://internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/mi500-preview :sparkles: 

deploy-bot: canaries deployed -> ap-sin-a, eu-amsterdam-b. Canary run ID: rbw-can-2120001111. Health checks: green so far.

finance-bot: note: preview pricing is discounted for first 3 months. New billing code: `DED-MI500-PREVIEW`. Finance will publish mapping doc by EOD.

luca: Are we offering migration credits for teams moving from existing reserved pools? Need to know for outreach.

joanne: Yes 9: for customers who sign up in this preview and opt to migrate within 60 days were offering a one-time credit equal to 5% of their remaining commitment value (sales approval required). I'll attach the playbook.

devex-bot: Heads-up for SDKs: runtime now exposes pool type `mi500`. Update clients to accept `pool: "mi500"` in reserve calls. PR landing: https://git.internal.redwood.ai/devex/mi500-pool-support

paul: Ops ask 9: any known perf caveats? sequence length or batch-size things we should warn customers about?

joanne: Good call. Early notes: strong single-GPU throughput on short-to-medium contexts (1k-16k). For models >70B with long contexts we recommend multi-GPU configs only after perf review. Also temporary hotspot on KV cache eviction for very bursty workloads 9: SRE should watch eviction_rate and mem_alignment errors. Suggested alerts: `sum(rate(kv_evictions[5m])) > 0` and p95 latency > 600ms.

nina: Runtime question: do customers need a new image?

joanne: No new base image. They need to enable the mi500 microkernel flag in runtime flags: `RUNTIME_KERNEL_SET=mi500` or via Console toggle. We have a fallback path but performance will be suboptimal without the kernel set.

luca: Legal/compliance note: private deployments (VPC) need an extra firmware attestation step for mi500 before we allow dedicated reservation. Legal is drafting the clause.

paul: Who owns the rollout comms to existing Dedicated customers? I can help segment top 50 by spend for targeted outreach.

joanne: Sales Ops + Growth will run the campaign. Paul, please coordinate with @sales-ops and export top50. I'll provide templated email + migration credit language.

deploy-bot: Reminder: metrics dashboard created at /dashboards/dedicated/mi500-preview. Panels: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, kv_evictions, gpu_util, temp.

joanne: Opt-in CLI example:
```
redwood reserve create --pool mi500 --region ap-sin --commit 3mo --gpus 2 --contact team@example.com --preview
```
joanne: Known limitations in preview: no preemptible instances, no auto-scaling for mi500 pools, and HSM KMS rotations require a manual step. We'll remove limitations after full launch.

nina: I'll update the runbooks and add the kernel flag example.

luca: Great. Anything else?

joanne: Follow-ups: perf report next Tue, migration playbooks by Fri, and a small internal office hours session for SRE/sales on Wed 14:00 UTC. I'll post invite. :calendar:
